topic: At the Shinjuku Showdown, when Sukuna and Gojo's domains finally clashed, Sukuna's Malevolent Shrine overpowered Gojo's Unlimited Void for the first time ever
title: Sukuna's Domain Beat Gojo's
description: History's strongest sorcerer met an ancient king in Shinjuku. When their domains clashed, Malevolent Shrine cut through Unlimited Void—something that had never happened to Gojo before. Gojo spent the entire fight healing himself just to survive each guaranteed hit.
comment: Is Sukuna actually stronger than Gojo, or did Gojo just have a bad day against a King a thousand years old?

lines.text: Gojo's Unlimited Void made him untouchable to almost everyone else in the series.

shot.fallback: untouchable sorcerer surrounded by infinite space

lines.text: Sukuna's Malevolent Shrine cuts through everything in a two-hundred-meter radius the instant it opens.

shot.fallback: massive domain cutting through everything nearby

lines.text: When their domains clashed in Shinjuku, Malevolent Shrine overpowered Unlimited Void, which had never happened to Gojo before.

shot.fallback: unprecedented domain clash overwhelming a legend

lines.text: Gojo absorbed hit after guaranteed hit, losing ground with every second inside that domain.
He used reverse cursed technique at full output just to heal fast enough to keep standing at all.

shot.search: Gojo reverses technique full output healing
shot.fallback: desperate healing just to remain standing

lines.text: Two of the strongest beings alive were trading blows that would have ended almost anyone in a single hit.
At his lowest point, badly hurt and his technique temporarily gone, Gojo still fought smart and found a way to recover.

shot.fallback: battered fighter refusing to give up

lines.text: But that one moment where Gojo wasn't ready, Sukuna landed exactly the blow it took to finally end the match...

shot.search: Sukuna final blow Gojo match end
shot.fallback: decisive strike ending an epochal battle

self_check.hook: line 1 establishes Gojo's power, line 2-3 introduce the impossible (Sukuna wins domain clash)
self_check.loop: last line returns to the final strike that ended an epochal battle without exact repetition
